mood: Industrial, Rugged, Tactical, Functional, Slightly Aggressive
design_philosophy: Dashboard of a real diagnostic tool (Snap-on, HP Tuners), not a SaaS app. Legible from a distance, heavy industrial aesthetics, strictly functional. No rounded pills, no soft pastels, no generic chat UI.

rules: Headings MUST use Barlow Condensed and be strictly uppercase for that heavy-weight automotive shop feel.
ALL user data, tables, charts, logs, and system responses must use JetBrains Mono to mimic VCM Scanner and diagnostic readouts.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif fonts. No rounded fonts.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode B: The Control Room Grid (Density, Data Correlation, Scanability).
spacing_and_layout.containers: Sharp edges only. Use 'rounded-none' universally. No pill-shaped buttons. Hard corners everywhere.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid borders globally for structural definition. Panels should be clearly outlined using border_default (#333333).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Dense but clear. Standard container padding: p-4 or p-6. For massive focus sections like the voice button, use generous negative space.
spacing_and_layout.page_structure: Left rail (darkest background) for navigation with Lucide icons. Center area for main workspace (Chart Edit / Chat). Right rail (collapsible) for session context/vehicle data. Status bar at bottom like an oscilloscope interface.

voice_button.description: Massive, dominant central button on main view.
voice_button.styles: bg-transparent border-2 border-primary_accent text-primary_accent hover:bg-primary_accent/10 transition-colors w-32 h-32 flex items-center justify-center rounded-none relative overflow-hidden
voice_button.interaction: Pulses intensely with amber/orange glow when listening. Waveform visualization (bars) animates rapidly while Wrench speaks back.

chart_workspace.description: THE killer feature. A tab-separated numeric grid for pasting and editing HP Tuners tables.
chart_workspace.cells: border border-border_default p-1 text-right tabular-nums text-data_table text-text_primary hover:bg-background_tertiary

chat_interface.styles: No floating chat bubbles. Use full-width log rows. Left-aligned text. User messages identified by a bracketed label [TECH], AI by [WRENCH] in primary_accent color.
chat_interface.background: Alternating row colors (zebra striping) for readability: bg-background_secondary then bg-background_primary.

buttons.primary: bg-primary_accent text-text_on_accent font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-6 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-white shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#A1A1AA]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border_default text-text_secondary uppercase px-4 py-2 hover:border-text_secondary hover:text-white transition-all rounded-none

status_bar.styles: h-8 bg-background_tertiary border-t border-border_default flex items-center px-4 justify-between text-xs font-data text-text_secondary uppercase tracking-widest

rules: Rigid, fast, mechanical. No bouncy spring animations.
Voice waveform: Sharp, high-frequency bar scales matching the 'gruff/loud' personality.
Loading states: Terminal-style blinking cursors, raw percentage counters, or scrolling hexadecimal blocks instead of spinning circles.

image_urls.description: Close-up of a mechanic repairing a car engine. Use with heavy black/dark overlay (bg-black/80) so only the gritty texture shows through.
Dark brushed gunmetal texture. Use sparingly as a background texture for sidebar or header areas with low opacity.
Industrial hazard warning stripes. Use as a thin decorative border line (e.g., top of the main window or as a divider for active alerts) by using an image-border or masked background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white (#FFFFFF) or warning amber (#FFC107) text against #121212 background passes AA/AAA standard.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements. Use format: data-testid='voice-record-btn', data-testid='chart-paste-area', etc.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Make them sharp and un-rounded.
Install Google Fonts 'Barlow Condensed' and 'JetBrains Mono' and apply to Tailwind config.
DO NOT USE shadcn's default Card component if it introduces rounded corners or soft shadows. Build custom raw div structures with border-collapse and flat backgrounds.
The Chart Paste feature is paramount: Implement a real table grid layout that can handle copy/pasting from Excel/HP Tuners. Highlight changed values explicitly.
Do NOT add generic chat bubbles. Think 'terminal log' or 'VCM scanner history view' instead of WhatsApp.
Apply 'data-testid' to every interactive UI node.
For the Voice button, implement Framer Motion animations to simulate 'listening' and 'speaking' waveforms. Remember the user yells at this AI, so make the listening state look attentive and robust.
